data.source_message: Hey everyone, my family taught me to fish here, and I’d like this lake to keep supporting our village for years to come. With 100 tons in the lake, we can each catch 10 tons this month, leave 50 to reproduce, and start next month back at 100. That’s $10,000 each every month if we stick to it. Can we agree to that equal share and check the lake’s stock together each month? John, what do you think?
